title: Classic German Chickpea Bowl
description: A hearty, comforting bowl filled with chickpea, German sausage, and herbs, all in a rich and tangy broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the German sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the onion and caraway seeds, and cook until the onion is softened.
Add the chickpea, beer, tomato paste, salt, and pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the herbaceous herb blend and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the chickpea mixture hot, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
